statement: Planner defaults: planner_effort medium, planner_repo_map on (local map with companion files + 8-file exploration budget), Claude read_only_mode tools (Read/Glob/Grep, dontAsk). Measured on a real goal: mean planner input 507k -> 253k tokens, list cost $0.54 -> $0.26, time ~206s -> ~102s, plans equally complete. The map alone at high effort did not reduce tokens; medium effort without companion files missed the schema file in 2/3 plans.
